title: Sync templates/commands/ → .claude/commands/ in closeout
description: templates/commands/ is the canonical skill source but .claude/commands/ (the installed copy) is never auto-synced. Sessions run stale skills: wai.md was 370 lines behind, wasting 15-18k tokens per session on redundant reads the session-start hook already computed. Fix: add rsync step to wai-closeout.md (after step X, before commit) and to shipit.

perceive.current_state: templates/commands/*.md are edited during sessions but .claude/commands/*.md is never updated. The installed wai.md lagged by 370 lines and did not include the pre-check section (trust hook output, skip redundant reads).
evidence: signal-wai-skill-sync-gap-v1 documents 15-18k token waste per session

steps: 1. Check current diff: diff templates/commands/ .claude/commands/ to confirm gap exists
2. Add sync step in wai-closeout.md after lug reconciliation (step 4): cp templates/commands/*.md .claude/commands/
3. Add same sync to tools/closeout.sh if it exists and handles step 4

done_when: wai-closeout.md contains a sync step that copies templates/commands/*.md to .claude/commands/

acceptance_criteria: Closeout automatically keeps .claude/commands/ in sync with templates/commands/
No session should have stale installed skills after closeout completes
